recipe.visualDefinition: A somber, atmospheric scene featuring a figure with large white wings lying face-down on a dark Victorian-style settee. The environment is a distressed, dimly lit room with a patterned tile floor and a string of glowing bulbs in the background, all unified by a heavy, grainy sepia-toned texture.
coreVisualRelationships: The bright white of the wings contrasts against the dark silhouette of the sofa.
The horizontal line of the sofa anchors the composition against the verticality of the background textures.
The glowing string lights provide a rhythmic counterpoint to the large, flowing script above.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and distressed paper texture overlay.
Desaturated, warm sepia and olive color palette.
Central placement of the winged figure on the furniture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The winged figure and sofa occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, ornate back of the Victorian settee.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large script at the top, move down to the glowing lights, and rest on the white wings at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant textured space at the top and sides creates a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted sepia and olive-grey tones for the environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal for the sofa silhouette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellow-white for the string lights and wings.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast between the dark furniture and the bright highlights of the wings.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a high-contrast, slanted script with exaggerated, looping flourishes on initial capitals.
Secondary text is a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.
Stroke weight in script varies from hairline to medium.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' features a large, circular flourish that encompasses the beginning of the word.
Lower-case descenders are elongated and slightly distressed.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of ornate, organic script with rigid, modern geometric sans.

preserve: The wide tracking of the subtitle
avoid: Modern bold sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the ornate, formal flourishes of the primary title.
Provides the clean, geometric contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a moody, sepia-toned image of a dark Victorian settee in a room with distressed walls and a patterned tile floor. A figure with large, detailed white angel wings lies face-down on the sofa. Include a horizontal string of glowing warm bulbs in the upper background. Apply a heavy film grain and paper texture overlay.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large, ornate script title in the top third, slightly off-center to the left, using a cream color. Below it, center a subtitle in a clean, all-caps geometric sans-serif with wide letter spacing in a dark charcoal tone.

verificationChecks: Is the script title large and flourishing?
Is the overall tone desaturated and sepia-heavy?
Are the wings the brightest element in the lower half?
Is the subtitle clearly legible and widely spaced?

adjustableVariables: Number of glowing bulbs in the background
postGenerationChecks: Check for texture consistency across the text and image.
Ensure the script flourishes do not obscure the subtitle.
Verify the lighting on the wings matches the ambient glow of the bulbs.
Confirm the tile pattern is appropriately aged and faded.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a Victorian-era subject with heavy grunge textures, a sepia-olive palette, and a high-contrast pairing of ornate script and minimalist sans-serif typography.
